rules.title: Public network access enabled
rules.description: A data-plane service is explicitly reachable through its public endpoint, increasing exposure and complicating private-path assurance.
rules.remediation: Disable public network access and validate Private Endpoint, private DNS, routing and trusted operational access.

rules.title: Blob public access allowed
rules.description: The storage account permits public blob access and can enable accidental anonymous publication.
rules.remediation: Set blob public access to false and use scoped identity-based access.

rules.title: Insufficient log retention
rules.description: Retention below 30 days can prevent incident investigation and operational trend analysis.
rules.remediation: Set retention from workload investigation, regulatory and cost requirements; use at least 30 days for this baseline.

rules.title: Single-node production capacity
rules.description: A node count of one creates a node-level single point of failure for a production Kubernetes workload.
rules.remediation: Use a workload-justified minimum node count, autoscaling and disruption testing across availability zones.

rules.title: Legacy TLS minimum configured
rules.description: The resource permits a protocol version below TLS 1.2.
rules.remediation: Require TLS 1.2 or later and test every dependent client before rollout.

rules.title: Premium SKU requires economic justification
rules.description: A Premium service tier is being selected without an adjacent unit-economics declaration.
rules.remediation: Record demand, utilization, SLO and unit-cost assumptions in the architecture decision record.
